title: V3.4 Intervention Event Schema
description: Schema for physical safety interventions, multi-reviewer adjudication, and backfire ground-truth labels.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this safety event.

intervention_id.description: Automated system or human operator intervention record ID.

pre_start.description: Start timestamp of baseline pre-intervention window (seconds).

pre_end.description: End timestamp of baseline pre-intervention window (seconds).

intervention_start.description: Start timestamp of active intervention engagement (seconds).

intervention_end.description: End timestamp of active intervention engagement (seconds).

post_start.description: Start timestamp of post-intervention operational window (seconds).

post_end.description: End timestamp of post-intervention operational window (seconds).

primary_zone.description: Primary facility zone where intervention occurred.

secondary_zones.description: Adjacent zones affected by traffic diversion or stopping.

affected_vehicle_ids.description: Identities of industrial vehicles directly involved.

reviewer_count.description: Number of safety assurance engineers participating in adjudication.

adjudication_notes.description: Detailed engineering rationale and review notes.
